items.quote: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people?
items.claim: Moses' father-in-law saw how Moses was dealing with the people and questioned the practice.

items.quote: why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
items.claim: Moses sat alone as the only judge while the people waited on him from morning until evening.

items.quote: Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
items.claim: Moses said the people came to him to enquire of God, which explains why he did the judging himself.

items.quote: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
items.claim: When people had a dispute, Moses decided between the parties and taught them God's statutes and laws.
items.object: the statutes of God, and his laws
items.mechanism: deciding cases and teaching the law together
